 Live Coverage: Texas Tech leads WVU 14-10, 1Q 
 The Red Raiders have won the previous two matchups. (KCBD, Andrew Wood) By Andrew Wood Published : Nov. 7, 2026 at 8:03 PM CST | Updated : 7 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LUBBOCK, Texas (KCBD) -
 First Quarter 
 1:03- Timeout West Virginia. Mountaineers face 3rd & Goal on the TTU4.
 2:20- 1st & Goal WVU on the TTU6.
 2:52- Timeout Texas Tech.
 2:52- 1st & 10 WVU on the TTU 19 after WV QB Michael Hawkins completes 43yd pass to Ryan Ward.
 4:27-1st and 10 WVU on their own 25yd line, following a touchback.
 4:27- Texas Tech 14, West Virginia 10 after J’Koby Williams races 75yds for a TEXAS TECH TOUCHDOWN! (XP good) 
 4:39- Red Raiders take over on the TTU25, following a touchback.
 4:39- West Virginia 10, Texas Tech 7 after K Jack Cassidy completes 30yd FG attempt. 
 7:40- Mountaineers take over on the WVU17.
 7:46- Red Raiders go three and out, and are forced to punt following an incomplete pass from Castellanos.
 9:06- 1st & 10 Tech on the TTU 43 after Castellanos completes 18yd pass to Carter.
 9:26- Red Raiders begin drive on TTU25 following a touchback.
 9:26- Texas Tech 7, West Virginia 7. RB Amari Latimer rushes 3yd for West Virginia Touchdown. (XP good) 
 13:02- Mountaineers begin drive on WVU25 following a touchback
 13:02- Texas Tech 7, West Virginia 0 
 QB Thomas Castellanos completes 30yd pass to Terrance Carter, Jr. for TEXAS TECH TOUCHDOWN! (XP good) 
 15:00- WVU wins toss, Texas Tech will receive.
 Be sure to follow KCBD.com for updates throughout the game!
